title: Delta's Thanksgiving Meltdown, a Norovirus Flight to Frankfurt, and Why Premium Seats Are Beating Economy
summary: Delta kicks off Thanksgiving week with a tech outage that snarls the world's busiest airport, a Condor flight to Frankfurt turns into a medical emergency with dozens sick mid-air, and Madrid's airport traps thousands of passengers when the trains quit. Plus, Korean Air's booking data reveals a surprising shift in how people buy plane tickets.
